name: Kadokura Kazuya
source:
"Why do humans forget things about the past?"

He is not shy and can talk to almost anyone. He may seem carefree, but he can read the room and gauge distance. Despite being young, knows the importance of "normal things" from experiences years ago.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara01.html]official website[/url]]
